### Believing God for Seasons of Joy Again
Author: Meredith Houston Carr
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-7-2021.html
Passage: Genesis 48:11
Points:
- Prolonged suffering and loss can tempt us to believe our best days are behind us.
- Jacob endured years of heartbreak over the loss of Joseph, likely believing joy would never return.
- God redeemed Jacob's pain beyond expectations by restoring Joseph and allowing him to meet his grandsons.
- Even when circumstances make no sense, God continually works behind the scenes for our good.
- Believers can run to God with their grief and choose to hope for seasons of joy ahead.

### Lasting Impact
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-october-14-2023.html
Passage: Genesis 48:5
Points:
- Jacob elevates Joseph's sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, adopting them to share directly in the family inheritance.
- Jacob faces his final hours in the intimacy of his home bed, surrounded by those he loves.
- Approaching death, the grandfather lays hands on his grandsons and speaks wise words of blessing over them.
- A godly elder's intentional farewell leaves an enduring spiritual impact on the next generations.

### Joseph's Protest
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/josephs-protest
Passage: Genesis 48:15-20
Points:
- Jacob remembers the Lord as his lifelong shepherd and the redeeming angel who delivers from evil.
- Joseph objects when Jacob crosses his hands to place the primary blessing upon the younger brother.
- Jacob knowingly bypasses cultural birthright customs to illustrate God's unmerited grace.
- God distributes His gifts and favor according to His sovereign pleasure rather than human expectation.
- Believers are reminded that salvation is rooted purely in divine mercy rather than human merit.
